worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.summary: Leave an unseeable force at a chosen spot: a faint mirage hangs there, then the force closes from all sides and grips every foe on that patch for special damage, with a chance to flinch. Ambush form lingers longer with a larger, heavier grip; immediate form closes faster with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.use.0: Predict where a foe will run and leave the unseen force on that spot
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.use.1: Hold a sleeping or rooted target in place
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.use.2: Grip a small cluster of foes at once
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.descripti: The grip deals %1$s special damage over a %2$s-block patch.
The force lands within %1$s blocks; the mirage lingers %2$s before closing.
A gripped target has a %1$s chance to flinch for %2$s.
It gathers about %1$s threads of force; ambush form is currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.growth.0: From level %1$s the grip rises to %2$s and the patch to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.extrasensory.preferenc: On: the mirage lingers longer, the grip is wider and heavier, but the cooldown is longer — bet that the foe stops on the predicted spot; good against sleeping or rooted targets. Off (immediate form, default): it closes faster with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, but a smaller, lighter grip that relies on the foe standing still now.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values place the ambush from farther away.
